chapter: Hampton, New York and Lee's own band
title: His father's death and the end of the band
summary: Lee's father died around 1942 or 1943, and the band was not kept together after he came home from New York.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: So after I came back from New York, my dad did pass, and that must've been like '42 or '43. Now who did I go to work with? Where did I go to work?
Were you just -- what? You left your band at the Cafe Society?
You came back here then. And you didn't ever go back to it?

No. They didn't keep it. They disbande. Yeah, I had to be with it because nobody was gonna take care of the business, and I was kind of business oriented, and I took care of it, but that was really the end of the band. We didn't ever fool with it again.
